name: mk_q1_military
cmd:
O=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/out/mk_q1_military; mkdir -p $O
python3 decor_build.py -- --theme military --out $O --tex 512 --ao 4 --only Hesco_A,Hesco_B,Sandbags,Drums,Jerrycans,Ammo,Cones,LightTower,Fence,Barriers,Scrub_A,Scrub_B,Humvee,Hangar,Tower,Jet,Heli,FuelTruck,Radome,Rubble_A,Rubble_B,Wreck,Dish,Generator,AAGun,Pallet,Forklift --shots $O/shots --each > $O/build.log 2>&1 || (tail -40 $O/build.log; exit 1)
rm -f $O/kit_hi.blend; ls -la $O $O/shots
